user.title: Home To-Do
user.description:
Adds the Home To-Do page to the sidebar, for every user.

Removing Home To-Do later keeps every list in `.storage/home_todo`, so adding it again brings them back.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home To-Do is already set up.

init.title: Home To-Do
init.description: Removing Home To-Do keeps every list in `.storage/home_todo`, so adding it again brings them back. To delete the lists for good, delete that file as well.

data_description.name: Shown at the top of the page and in the sidebar, for everyone. For example, Lowry Home To-Do.
